initial_attempts.linux_full_suite: Seven errors due to unavailable old Xvfb display; restored existing Xvfb, verified Tk connection, reran full suite successfully. No failures hidden.
initial_attempts.browser_performance: Existing unchanged FPS assertion failed at19.8 while sharing CPU with full suite; rerun alone passed at29.6. Actual sustained physical performance remains unverified.

first_windows.finding: Toolbar checks passed; blank non-transient panel probe mismatched. Final probe uses actual transient button and consistent native coordinates with separate native-region/hit-target assertions. Four-test Windows preflight passed.

root_causes.recording: Unconnected WebAudio destination generated no audio clock; Chromium returned zero encoded chunks. Browser ignored failed finish state and announced success. Reproduced before fix against real backend; after fix nonempty media decodes.
root_causes.end_ordering: Native End dropped room and browser End sent remote closure before encoder drain. Explicit pending/deferred closure now waits for Stop and committed chunk finalization, not cloud processing on teacher PC.
root_causes.native_input: Fullscreen input HWND had no exclusions for control coordinates and relied on topmost order. Actual native-region holes protect toolbar/panels independently of raised input ordering; real Win32 CI acceptance recorded separately.
root_causes.ui_blocking: Synchronous UI-thread HTTP in native end/close/Video/screen controls; now owned asynchronous workers and nonblocking local teardown.

bilingual draft policies/student Remember Me/Argos/Website Management
